target_customer: Fintechs, neobanks, marketplaces and wallets that need to collect and pay out money across Latin America and other emerging markets
problem: Moving money across local rails such as PIX, SPEI and bank transfers is fragmented. Infinia offers one API for local collections, payouts and virtual accounts, later bridged with stablecoins.
business_model: usage-based payments API with transaction and FX fees
product_category: payments infrastructure, account to account and stablecoin rails

founders.name: Ianai Urwicz
founders.background_notes: Former VP of Sales and Partnerships at dLocal with over 10 years in fintech, per the YC page.

founders.name: Alejandro Rettig
founders.background_notes: Reports more than 25 years in fintech and telecom across R&D, product and sales and more than 50 products deployed in Latin America, Africa and Asia, per the YC page.

competitors.name: Prometeo
competitors.what: Uruguay based open banking company that launched a pan regional account to account payments offering in Latin America

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to many local payment rails and compliance regimes is integration heavy, with regulation and banking partnerships as the hard parts more than research level engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Banking partnerships, licences and deep payment integrations take time to replicate, though similar aggregators existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquired or copied Infinia in the sources. It later pivoted toward stablecoin bridges and served Bridge, Ebanx and Mastercard per its site.

market_need_then: In 2022 Latin American fintechs needed local rail access as Pix grew and open finance expanded, and the launch post framed Infinia as a Pay By Bank API for the region.

branding.domain_note: Started on infiniaweb.com and later moved to the shorter infinia.xyz (date not found).

brand_strength.rationale: Covered by Latin American fintech outlets but little brand specific coverage. The name is shared with other companies, such as an unrelated InfinitusPay result.

pivots.from: Account to account Pay By Bank API for Latin America
pivots.to: Stablecoin and local currency virtual accounts and payouts infrastructure
pivots.why: Not stated. The YC launch post differs from the current description.

outcome_analysis: Infinia was founded by a former dLocal sales head and an experienced fintech technologist, took 500 thousand dollars from YC in late 2022 and moved from Pay By Bank toward stablecoin and local rail infrastructure. It now names Bridge, Ebanx and Mastercard as customers and raised a 13.5 million dollar Series A in July 2026 co-led by Bain Capital and Variant Fund. It remains independent and growing.
notes: Founding year conflicts: 2021 (CB Insights, Dealroom), 2022 (YC), 2023 (other). The 500K is YC's reported investment, not a priced round. The Series A has no stated valuation. Series A investor list from a single outlet summary beyond the two leads. Whether other seed money was raised is not known.
